run_boost_build_test_default_features: run the Boost.Build test script that verifies features with default values are present in build properties
test_boostbuild_tester_write: test the BoostBuild Tester write method to create jamroot.jam and jamfile.jam build files
test_boostbuild_tester_run_build_system: test the BoostBuild Tester run_build_system method to execute the B2 build process
test_boostbuild_tester_expect_addition: test the BoostBuild Tester expect_addition method to verify compiled output binaries exist
test_boostbuild_tester_cleanup: test the BoostBuild Tester cleanup method to remove temporary build artifacts after testing
